name: Mathiel
summary: Furen Longbeard sends his crafting notes across the sea to Mathiel in Darnassus. The night elf smith works on the Warrior's Terrace, where dwarven mail forging may reach a new pair of hands.

sections.title: A Courier Across the Sea
sections.body: Furen Longbeard has mastered the forging of fire-hardened armor and chooses to share what he has learned with other Alliance craftsmen. He copies his technical diagrams and sends you across the continents to Mathiel, a smith on Teldrassil.

sections.title: Kaldorei Steel and Dwarven Craft
sections.body: On Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, Mathiel tends a forge for the Sentinels and other fighters who defend the night elf capital. Furen's notes carry dwarven methods from the underground forges of Khaz Modan to kaldorei armorers, whose craft is shaped by their bond with nature.

faq.answer: Mathiel is a night elf blacksmith on the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus. He makes equipment for the capital's defenders and corresponds with smiths across the Alliance.

faq.q: Why does Furen send you to Darnassus?
faq.answer: Furen Longbeard wants other Alliance craftsmen to benefit from his work on fire-hardened armor. He sends you to carry his crafting notes to Mathiel, a colleague able to study the techniques.

faq.q: Where can I find Mathiel in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Mathiel works at the forge on Darnassus's Warrior's Terrace, in the eastern district by the main gate, where warriors and Sentinels train.

faq.q: What happens after giving Mathiel the notes?
faq.answer: After receiving Furen's notes, Mathiel is impressed by the discoveries and sets out to build on the dwarven techniques. He sends you into Kalimdor's wilderness to gather rare materials, including sunscorched shells.

faq.q: What kind of notes are being delivered?
faq.answer: The notes hold Furen's observations and forging methods from experiments with scorched spider fangs, chimaera horns, and phlogiston to make reinforced mail.

faq.q: Is this quest restricted to warriors?
faq.answer: Yes. The delivery is part of the trials and training for Alliance warriors building their martial skill and knowledge of armorcraft.

angles.text: As a warrior, carrying Furen's notes takes you from the smithies of the Eastern Kingdoms to Darnassus's proving grounds, where your knowledge of armorcraft grows.
As a dwarf, sharing Furen's discovery with the night elves carries your people's pride in the forge across the sea.
As a night elf, you can see Mathiel's interest in dwarven smithing and its place beside kaldorei armorcraft.
As a blacksmith, you see master smiths share their craft as diagrams and heat tempering methods travel between distant forges.
